planned_title: Could a Robot Survive a Night on Mars?
spoken: On Mars, the night can fall to minus 90 degrees. Batteries hate deep cold, like your phone on a frozen day, so rovers burn power just to keep their insides warm. That only works while power keeps coming in. In 2009, Spirit got stuck and couldn't catch the winter sun. As the days shortened, its power fell.
